name: WebRip
description:
WebRip is a professional and advanced iOS tool designed to download entire websites or extract media content directly to your device. The application is powered by a customized wget engine, delivering high execution speed and reliable handling of complex links within an integrated and user-friendly terminal interface.

Key Features
Full website download: Allows downloading complete websites including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files for offline viewing
Images only mode: Provides a dedicated mode to extract only images and media from any URL with case-insensitive extension detection
Optimized wget engine: Includes a custom-built wget compiled for arm64 and arm64e architectures to ensure full compatibility and fast performance on both newer and older iPhone models
Broad environment support: Works reliably on Roothide jailbreak, Rootless jailbreak, and TrollStore installations
Advanced export and sharing: Enables exporting downloaded folders as a single organized ZIP archive with options to open directly in Filza or the native Files app
Interactive terminal: Features a built-in terminal window to monitor download progress in real time with error logging and progress tracking
author: GhostTechXx
changelog:
Changelog for Version 2.0
Added full support for modern arm64e processors on A12 and newer devices
Introduced official images-only mode as a core option within the download engine
Fixed download success detection logic to confirm completion based on actual file presence rather than exit codes alone
Resolved directory permission issues encountered during TrollStore installations
Improved progress bar accuracy and responsiveness when handling large website downloads
improvements:
Technical Improvements in Version 2.0
Improved engine stability through refined process handling using posix_spawn to prevent unexpected termination in TrollStore environments
Automatic settings management with auto-save functionality to preserve user configurations when navigating inside the application
Enhanced file organization using a new algorithm that cleans and normalizes folder names extracted from URLs, making them easier to locate in file managers
Complete Arabic localization for all interface text, error messages, and warnings
